theorems.VietorisOrdinals.second_countable: The compact-range Vietoris power with countable index is second-countable for every second-countable ground space.
theorems.VietorisOrdinals.not_sigmaCompact: An injective enumeration of a compact convergent-sequence-type set with isolated finite values yields non-sigma-compactness, by the delayed diagonal.
theorems.VietorisOrdinals.not_menger: Under the same structural hypotheses, the compact-range power fails the standard Menger selection property for arbitrary open covers.
theorems.VietorisOrdinals.ordinal_main: For every actual ordinal between omega and omega one, the specified compact-range power is second-countable, Lindelof and not sigma-compact.
theorems.VietorisOrdinals.ordinal_full: The complete principal ordinal theorem, including failure of the Menger property.
theorems.VietorisOrdinals.ordinal_subsets_countab: Every subset of each countable ordinal interval has cardinality at most aleph zero.

principal_statement: For every a : Ordinal.{0} with omega0 < a and a < omega 1, K(Set.Iio a) is second-countable, Lindelof, not sigma-compact, and not Menger.
ground_topology: Order topology on actual mathlib Ordinal.{0}, inherited by Set.Iio a
